text.body: rāvaṇabaiṭh padādi nihatā kāraḥ padānto naḥ padāntataḥ pragṛhaśca padādyātsyādiṃgyaṃ śliṣṭāvasānakam 1 sāṃhitaṣṣoṇaśca sāṃhitassandhāvaidauccorddhvapadādigaḥ padāntondaḥ padāntādīdūdvisargaśca ṣoḍaśa 2 kramātsyuṣṣoḍaśa sveṣu gaṇasaṃjñāḥ pṛthakpṛthak dvābhyāndvābhyāṃ gaṇāstvādau bhaveyuśca trayaḥ kramāt 3 tatasturīya ekena dvābhyāṃ pañcama ucyate tatastribhirgaṇaṣṣaṣṭhassaptamaśca tribhistathā 4 bhavedaṣṭama ekena bbhyevamaṣṭagaṇā smṛtāḥ saptānāmādau viṣamasamasaṃkhyāprasūcakam 5 aṣṭamasya gaṇasyeha syātsaṃkhyā pratipādakam pratipañcāśadekaikamakṣaraṃ procyate kramāt 6 caturbhiḥ pañcabhiṣṣaṭbhistribhissaptabhireva vā aṣṭabhirnavabhirvātra daśabhirvākṣaraiḥ kvacit 7 kriyate caivamekaikaṃ vākyaṃ baiṇṇāmalakṣaṇam hānvesminrādau laḥ kaḥ pṭassaṃkhyeyā āditaḥ kramāt 8 rādisādipṛthakpañca tatra saṃkhyā bhavetpunaḥ anṛvarṇaplutalṛkārālakṣyā aṣṭasvarāḥ kramāt 9 dajau bamau nakaḍagāḥ yarau vaikādaśo halaḥ anye tu rasadādibhyo na lakṣyā ajjhalastviha 10 alakṣyavarṇā yatra syustānatra parivarjayet ādāvījāvabāpūmāvenāvai kāciḍāvugau 11 tattat gaṇaṃ tu saṃhatya vigaṇairyaikarūpataḥ tatsamāsamasaṃkhyāsā dṛṣṭavyā tatra tatra ca 12 yadyādījau viṣamo jñeya ādāvādigaṇassamaḥ ūmau dvitīyo viṣama abau cettu samasmṛtaḥ 13 sama enau tṛtīya syāt yadyaikau viṣamo bhavet etat gaṇatrayañcātra ugau cedviṣamaṃ bhavet 14 uḍau yadi tadevātra samaṃ syāditi niścitaḥ ekalakṣyagaṇastveṣu samaṃ vā viṣamaṃ yadā 15 gaṇadvayaṃ tadanyattu bhavettadviparītakam ādādīnāṃ dvikāṣṭānāṃ varṇau pūrvottarau kramāt 16 turīyasya gaṇasyātra samāsamavisūcakau dvikāṣṭakeroyovā cet pañcamasya gaṇasya tu 17 vaiṣamyaṃ tatra saṃlakṣyaṃ narayau cetsamaṃ tathā vaścet ṣaṣṭhagaṇasyātra vaiṣamyaṃ vona cetsamaḥ 18 saptamasya gaṇasyeha samaṃ syādrādipañcake suvijñeyassaptamasya viṣamassādipañcake 19 visargānnaṣṭamagaṇā pañcakān pañcakāniha nirasya tu krimaṇāntyagaṇanāyāṃ rasādibhiḥ 20 ekadvitricatuḥpañcetyevaṃ saṃkhyāṃ vinirṇayet rādayondaparāścetsyurvisargābhāvasūcakāḥ 21 akhaṇḍamārgapadantvatra na lakṣyaṃ bhavatīha tu atretyantopasargā syuḥ paretyetyādayastathā 22 na te padāntalakṣyeṣu gaṇanīyā syuratra hi na dīrghagaṇaneṣvatra saṃkhyeyaḥpragrahastathā 23 lakṣyābhāvo yatra yatra tatra tatra samasmṛtaḥ yajuṣi pratipañcāśadevamevonnayetsadā 24 iti rāvaṇabaiṭparibhāṣā samāptā
